segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Ector,role:Knight,race:human,gender:male,align:lawful
OPTIONS=!legacy,!splash_screen,pettype:none
MSGTYPE=norep "You read: .*"
MSGTYPE=norep "Something is engraved here on the floor."

comment: MSGTYPE=norep on both lines of a tutorial engraving. The Knight steps off the first engraving and back twice; the two lines alternate, so each differs from gp.prevmsg and pline.c vpline() returns before putmesg() for MSGTYP_NOREP when the line equals gp.prevmsg never applies.
